name: Kasey Oomen
story: LINZ and the Geospatial Capability Committee included Kasey Oomen in the Leaving School geospatial career-profile series: Resilience Advisor, LINZ, October 2020.
A LINZ geospatial student or graduate profile records Kasey Oomen: LINZ Resilience Advisor; GIS study linked to CIMS and resilience work.

contentSections.title: Documented contribution in 2019
paragraphs: Kasey Oomen’s PLACE19 presentation addressed LINZ’s resilience and climate-change work, including key datasets and their fitness for purpose, formal emergency response and regulatory issues. Her biography identifies her as a resilience advisor at LINZ in 2019.
